questions.question_text: Describe any two features of arid soils.
key_points: Low humus content / poor moisture retention
Can be cultivated with proper irrigation
questions.notes: Any two correct features earn full marks; each valid point is worth 1 mark up to the max.

questions.question_text: Explain the effectiveness of horizontal distribution of power in the context of India.
key_points: Power is shared among different organs at the same level (legislature, executive, judiciary)
Each organ checks and balances the others
Prevents concentration of power in one hand / ensures accountability
questions.notes: Answer sheet contains a caret-inserted correction (the word 'horizontal' added above the line) - a good handwriting-correction test case.

questions.question_text: What changes did the Government of India make in its economic policies in the beginning of 1991? Explain.
key_points: Liberalisation - removal of barriers/restrictions on foreign trade and investment
Globalisation - integration with the world economy
Reduction of import tariffs, encouragement of FDI / MNCs, Special Economic Zones
questions.notes: Answer sheet contains a crossed-out word ('bro') mid-sentence - required 'handle crossed-out lines' test case.

questions.question_text: Mention any two economic impacts of the First World War on India.
key_points: War expenditure financed by loans and increased taxes (customs duties, income tax introduced)
Prices of goods increased sharply (near doubling 1913-1918), causing hardship
Widespread famines and the influenza epidemic that killed millions
questions.notes: Contains a caret-inserted phrase correction mid-answer.

questions.question_text: How does democracy establish an accountable, responsible and legitimate government? Explain.
key_points: Accountable - government answerable to citizens through elections
Responsible - transparency, rule-following, right to information
Legitimate - government of the people, based on majority consent, even if slower
